notes.title: Patch Notes 7214_413
notes.content:

[*] Updating and improving AI logic
[*] Updated Animation System
[*] New and Updated VO's
[*] Nyx - Turret has been replaced with Blockade

notes.title: The Revolution Enters Beta!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that RoboSquad has officially moved to Beta! Before we get into all of the changes, here's a message from us:

[b]Welcome to the beginning of a [u]Grand Revolution[/u][/b]

Your decision to join us in the Early Access Alpha of our game is not just a choice to play; it's a choice to shape the future.

This early access phase is a unique opportunity for us to develop, innovate, and expand together. Expect to see incredible battles, strategic masteries, advanced technology and, of course, some unexpected glitches.

Yes, you'll encounter bugs, and we're counting on you to help us find and squash them. Your feedback is not just valued - it's vital. [url=http://robosquadrevolution.com/]Visit our Website[/url] for all the ways you can engage with us to help us enhance the experience.

Without you, this Revolution wouldn't be possible.

We are dedicated to building an exciting world that evolves and prospers, with your assistance. Thank you for your faith, your enthusiasm, and your support. Welcome to the uprising! Together, we shall rewrite history.

Now, onto the changelist:

[b]New System Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Continuing to improve the Gamepad experience
[*] New opening cinematic and tutorial
[*] End of Match flow has been revamped. The winning team screen now features your Zoran taunting!
[/list]
[b]New Gameplay Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Explosive barrels! There's also a special goo variant for Sanctions Labs
[/list]
[b]New Visual Features[/b]
[list]
[*] The enemy and ally Fresnel has been replaced with an outline
[*] You can now preview all throwdowns and abilities in the main menu
[*] You can now preview all weapons in the main menu
[/list]
[b]Maps[/b]
[list]
[*] Continued progress on Sanctions Labs
[/list]
[b]UI / UX[/b]
[list]
[*] The Inventory UI has been updated to reflect our new style!
[*] Murder train notification has been resized
[*] Killfeed size has been reduced
[*] New icons are present for all throwdowns and abilities
[/list]
[b]New Audio Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Ammo pickups now trigger a sound when you interact with them.
[/list]
[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Nyx's rocket boots Kinetic Charge drain and thrust has increased
[*] Nyx's threshold to be able trigger rocket boots has been significantly reduced
[*] Skrill's charge now consumes Kinetic Charge
[*] Piko's double dash now has a shorter cooldown
[*] Time to capture a Control Point has increased
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Samurai hat being see through on one side fixed
[*] Attachments now properly transition in and out for Holograms
[*] Gun Game winner XP now awarded properly
[*] Zoran turn table on titlescreen now
[*] Burst Rifle iconography now consistent across the experience
[*] Fixed audio settings being defaulted to 0
[*] Fixed controller sensitivities being defaulted to 0
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Some attachments aren't positioned correctly on certain classes
[*] Hovering over weapon pickups in close proximity won't update the weapon name
[*] End of Match Zoran positioning can be... erratic
[*] Rarely HUD throwdown icon pointers can get stuck on screen
[/list]

notes.title: The Final Countdown Pt. 2 (Version A.0.0.3554_508)
notes.content:
[u][b]New System Features[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Zoranium renamed to NOVA
[*] Ongoing Gamepad improvements
[*] Premium currency can now be purchased in the store
[*] Account Default items have been added
[/list]

[u][b]New Gameplay Features[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]  Two new classes have been added (They currently are set to loadouts 2 & 3 respectively)
[list]
[*] Heavy Class: Skrill
[*] Light Class: Piko[/list]
[*] Free For All modes now do a check to respawn you farther away from other players on death
[*] Fully Auto Assault Rifle added
[*] Remote charge added
[*] Explosive Barrels will now appear in the environment
[/list]
[u][b]New Class Features[/b][/u]
[u]Nyx[/u] 
[list]
[*] Has a deployable Turret
[*] Has a deployable Healing Tank
[*] Has a Thruster for his jump
[*] Has a Remote Charge explosive

[u]Skrill[/u]
[list]
[*] Has a Sprint that damages enemies
[*] Has a Charge Jump that damages enemies on landing

[*] Has Double Jump

[list]

[*] Ammo / Weapon Pickups and Objectives now show on Minimap
[/list]
[u][b]Balance Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Sprint is now only available on Skrill
[*] Double Jump is now only available on Piko
[*] Pistol RoF reduced and damage increased
[*] Burst Rifle accuracy reduced while moving
[*] Grenade Launcher projectile bounces reduced to 1 from 2
[*] Grenade Launcher projectile speed significantly increased
[*] Grenade Launcher Projectile gravity increased
[*] Rocket Launcher explosion area slightly increased
[*] Shotgun Falloff range decreased slightly
[*] Maximum Ammo size increased for all ammo types
[/list]

[list]
[*] Stuttering no longer happens in Spectator Cam
[*] Game no longer crashes leaving Zoranium Mine
[*] Long Range Throwdowns have been renamed
[*] Control Point Audio has been fixed
[*] Minimap Icons now stay in a fixed position
[*] Party widget will now properly hide when going in and out of other menus
[*] There is now a text indicator that a player in your part is ready rather than just dancing
[*] Party Ready option should now populate correctly
[*] Clients now get the Countdown as expected
[*] Quickplay now behaves as expected
[/list]

[u][b]Known Issues[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Parties will join a match, but will be distributed among the teams equally
[*] Host doesn’t have a kill feed on listen server
[/list]

notes.title: The Final Countdown (Version A.0.0.3097_442)
notes.content:
[u][b]New System Features[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Daily Challenges
[*] In Match Music Player
[*] Achievements
[*] Per weapon stats tracked for each weapon
[*] Gamepad Support has been completely revamped
[*] Dev tags have been added. Now you'll know when we're playing too!
[/list]

[u][b]New Gamemode[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Gun game added
[/list]

[u][b]New Gameplay Features[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Characters can be knocked down from abilities and some weapon related explosions
[*] Cannonball long range throwdown
[/list]

[u][b]New Visual Features[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Shift toward new stylistic direction
[*] Big X and Mr. Likeable have updated models
[*] Multiple new skins and accessories available in Store
[*] Levels now start with an animated camera preview
[*] Other players in the party now dance to signify they're "Ready"
[/list]

[u][b]Maps[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Zoranium Mines has been finalized
[*] Large Cognition Floor added
[/list]

[u][b]UI / UX[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Store is now accessible and items can be purchased for Z-Chips
[/list]

[u][b]New Audio Features[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Sound cutting issues have been fixed
[/list]

[u][b]Balance Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Sniper firing rate reduced, magazine reduced to two, damage reversed to previous values
[*] SMG damage increased, Fire rate reduced,  now deals non modified damage ( Headshots and body shots do the same damage), Lowered magazine capacity
[*] Grenade and Rocket launcher projectiles speed increased
[*] Rocket launcher starts with more ammo
[*] Grenade launcher firing rate reduced
[*] Max player cap has been changed to 16
[*] Grenades are now less bouncy and behave more realistically
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Close range throwdown system reworked, characters now align properly
[*] You can no longer jump when getting throwdowned
[*] Performance degradation fixed
[*] Random freeze should be fixed
[*] Party system and invites should behave as expected
[/list]

[u][b]Known Issues[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Training area needs overhauled (It's been removed from the experience till then)
[*] Post processing can be inconsistent across maps
[*] Not all maps recognize the shift in art direction yet
[*] Gamepad issues persist but are highly prioritized for next update
[*] Weapon names may not populate correctly when playing on Linux through Proton
[*] Weapon pickup notifications are inconsistent
[/list]

As always thanks to all of the users who provided feedback and helped us test out!

notes.title: Minor Patch Update August 16th (Version A.0.0.166)
notes.content:
[b][u]New System Features[/u][/b]
- Store is now active! (Your inventory will start empty, but there are lots of free skins available!)

[u][b]New Gameplay Features[/b][/u]
- New soft lock for Melee Weapon (While using a melee weapon your camera will automatically track your target)

[u][b]New Visual Features[/b][/u]
- New effects added when the Overclock state engages
- Camera now spectates killer on death (Let us know what you think!)
- New Attachments
- New Skins
- Melee weapons now has visual effects for impact
- Melee weapons now have an effect associated with their passive (Lifesteal / Shield Stacking)
- Sniper has more visual flare when firing

[b][u]UI / UX[/u][/b]
- Quit match option added at round end
- MVP is now displayed for objective based gamemodes at round end
- Store has been redesigned

[b][u]New Audio Features[/u][/b]
-New Sound FX queues added to control points and throwdowns

[b][u]Maps[/u][/b]
- New assets added to The Hall V2

[b][u]New Holograms[/u][/b]
- Lady Fawkes
- Nash
- Some Holograms have multiple outfits! Press on them again to see.

[b][u]New Close Range Throwdowns[/u][/b]
- Mr. Likeable

[b][u]Balance Changes[/u][/b]
- Melee has been rebalanced significantly
- Stagger is no longer as punishing (Looking at you, melee)
- Energy Beam (throwdown) aiming sensitivity increased

[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
- Training area is now working
- Weapon orientation issues for Throwdowns have been resolved
- Performance degradation issues may be resolved (Needs further testing)
- Hitch on Weapon Swap may be resolved (Needs further testing)

[b][u]Known Issues[/u][/b]
- Occasionally the loadout select screen will persist on spawn
- Game mode roulette is currently not working
- Occasionally leaving a match will sometimes make you unable to join a new one without restart
- Spectator cam can have some jitter
- AI can spawn in A poses (This issue resolves itself on respawn)
- Bullets can pass through the roof of Temple and Shrine on Hall V2
- End of match sequence can cause issues
- Sometimes cosmetic changes aren't reflected in game from the title screen
- Equipment screen is a little cluttered

notes.title: Everything's Under Control Update August 2nd (Version A.0.0.151)

The Control Point game mode has been added and is available on TheHall_V2 and Zenith Junction

[u][b]New System Features[/b][/u]
Dedicated servers (Will be enabled for special events)

Knockback and stagger added
Ammo pickups added and Weapon pickups reduced
General map adjustments for balancing

[u][b]Throwdowns[/b][/u]
Kill streaks activate "Overclock" state (Enables the use of throwdowns -> "F" and "G" keys)
Close range and long range throwdowns added

[b][u]New Close Range Throwdowns[/u][/b]
GetVerified2.0
Z - Kick

[b][u]New Long Range Throwdowns[/u][/b]
Energy Blast
Energy Beam

notes.title: Bugfix / Feature Update Patch A.0.0.76
notes.content:
[u][b]New Features[/b][/u]
Performance and Graphics Enhancements
Performance improvements
Environmental lighting improvements
Reworked Match Start up Sequence

[b][u]AI Bot Updates[/u][/b]
AI is now smarter

[b][u]Sound Design Improvements[/u][/b]
Redesigned sound effects for most weapons
Remixed overall sound levels

[u][b]Gameplay Additions[/b][/u]
Map roulette
New melee combo animation
New Aerial Attack and Charge Dash
Aerial Attack and Charge dash have been redesigned
New Animation and VFX for Double Jump (Thanks AdeptMasterN8!)

[u][b]Map Changes[/b][/u]
Updated Cognition Floor with new assets
Introduced new team spawn zones with team colored gates
Training Map HDRI

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
Bots move more accurately
Warm up spawns now on every map
You can no longer cancel reload animations (Thanks AdeptMasterN8!)
Aerial Attack no longer leaves the reticle behind (Thanks AdeptMasterN8!)
Joining audio no longer loops for every player in match
Quickplay made sessions can now reliably be joined
Boundary breaks are no longer possible on Zenith Junction (Thanks Quixotic!)
On first spawn clients will no long experience rubber banding (Thanks Erick!)
Scoreboard no longer jitters when spamming TAB
Graphics are more consistent across quality levels
Menus should no longer be able to get stuck on screen
Crashing on map transition has been fixed
Team / Enemy Fresnel is loading correctly (Thanks Ushio!)
Stairs and random collisions have been fixed in the Training Area (Thanks Quixotic!)
Skill icons no longer show up all as grenade
Immunity on Spawn has been added (Thanks Enadream!)
Damage numbers are now rounded
Charge Dash now displays properly in kill feed

[u][b]Balance Patch[/b][/u]
SMG Damage per Shot 7 -> 6
SMG Rate of Fire 800 -> 700
All guns have new upper ammo caps (Thanks AdeptMasterN8!)

[list]
[*] Light Weapons (Pistol, Nano Swarm)
[*] 120
[*] Medium Weapons (Rifle)
[*] 90
[*] Shotgun
[*] 30
[*] Explosive Small (Grenade Launcher)
[*] 30
[*] Explosive Large (Rocket Launcher)
[*] 8
[*] Sniper
[*] 16
[/list]
Weapon and health pickups have been redistributed across all maps (Thanks AdeptMasterN8!)

[u][b]Known Issues[/b][/u]
Charge Dash / Aerial possible desync
Ability to shoot through team doors
Melee desync issues
Grenade VFX needs reworking  (Thanks AdeptMasterN8!)
Bots get stuck in certain areas (Zenith Junction, Wacky Chaos)
Some controller UI navigation idiosyncrasies
No remappable keys (coming soon)
Sometimes spawn using pistol animations regardless of weapon
You can shoot through walls if you're too close to them

Special thanks to all of the users who helped us find these bugs! This wouldn't be possible without you playing and being excellent members of the Zorans community.

- Explosions (Grenades / Rockets) were not registering all hits properly, this is now fixed!
